prompt:
Create one landscape 3:2 architectural MOOD BOARD for a public Minecraft Java 1.21.1 build catalog. Plain warm light background, crisp vanilla Minecraft voxel blocks and pixel textures, no characters or animals. Title: "PIKE PLACE • SOUTH & EAST MARKETS". Small subtitle: "1.4 blocks / metre • dusk • Minecraft 1.21.1".

Layout: upper two thirds contain FOUR small complete-building-group thumbnail takes, each showing all four recognisable market buildings together, with subtly different parapet articulation, stepped massing interpretation and stall arrangement; retain flat roofs and the same site orientation in every take. Label A "STREET RHYTHM", B "STEPPED BLUFF", C "ATRIUM & CORNER", D "DUSK STALLS". Every take contains: Economy Market, two storeys of red-brown brick with a cream-trimmed arched glass atrium entrance facing Pike Street, white window frames, flat parapet roof and glazed atrium skylight; Corner Market, three storeys of red-brown brick, big arched ground-floor openings with produce stalls and canvas awnings, two upper rows of tall white-framed windows, projecting cornice and flat parapet; Sanitary Market, long two-storey cream stucco/concrete block with small upper windows, open-fronted shops, striped awnings, painted signs and exact entrance lettering "SANITARY PUBLIC MARKET"; Garden Center on Post Alley, small two-storey brick shop building with painted shop signs, exposed iron fire escape and flat roof. Clearly distinguish the long low cream building from the taller brick corner building. Exterior only, just shallow warm lit stalls visible through glass.

Orientation is fixed: x increases east/uphill toward 1st Avenue; west/low x slopes downhill to Elliott Bay. z increases southeast along Pike Place toward Pike Street. Pike Place runs along z just east of the Main Arcade; Sanitary Market faces west toward the arcade across the street. Economy and Corner occupy the south/Pike Street end, Garden Center sits north on Post Alley. Include a small axis key "+x EAST / UPHILL", "+z PIKE STREET", "WEST / BAY". Show terraced ground and exposed lower brick storeys on downhill west sides, foundations reaching the terrain. Never floating. Use irregular stepped footprints rather than simple rectangular towers. Modules are unrotated; local plot envelopes Economy 58x102, Corner 62x102, Sanitary 79x155, Garden 42x32 blocks. Indicative roof heights from local lowest terrain: 54, 39, 33, 17 blocks respectively; these are concept thumbnails, not construction plans.

Below thumbnails: FOUR close-up voxel detail callouts with fine leader lines and concise labels: 1 "ECONOMY • CREAM ARCH + GLASS ATRIUM" showing stepped cream arch and skylight; 2 "CORNER • ARCHED PRODUCE STALL" showing brick arch, striped canvas awning, white window frame and cornice; 3 "SANITARY • PAINTED ENTRANCE SIGN" showing SANITARY PUBLIC MARKET lettering, cream facade, warm shop glazing and stripe canopy; 4 "POST ALLEY • IRON FIRE ESCAPE" showing iron-bar railings, landings and brick shopfront.

Bottom strip: neatly spaced block swatches grouped by role, with exact lowercase namespaced Minecraft block ids legibly lettered under each swatch. WALLS: minecraft:bricks, minecraft:granite, minecraft:smooth_sandstone. TRIM: minecraft:smooth_quartz, minecraft:quartz_stairs. ROOF: minecraft:stone_slab, minecraft:gray_concrete. WINDOWS: minecraft:glass_pane, minecraft:white_stained_glass_pane. ACCENTS: minecraft:red_wool, minecraft:white_wool, minecraft:iron_bars, minecraft:lantern, minecraft:glowstone. Use only vanilla blocks that exist in Java 1.21.1, no pale oak or later blocks, no modded objects. Warm amber dusk window and stall lighting, restrained lanterns, red glowing sign accents only where signage is present. Keep sheet background light while the miniature building renders have dusk shading. Professional clear composition, readable labels, sharp cubic silhouettes, no photoreal curved architecture, no interiors beyond shop windows, no watermark.
reads: Economy Market’s cream stepped arch around a tall glazed entrance, with a glass atrium skylight above.
Red-brown brick market facades with pale window frames and trim.
Corner Market’s arched produce stalls beneath striped awnings.
Tall upper windows, projecting cornices and flat parapet roofs.
Sanitary Market’s long cream facade, small upper windows and SANITARY PUBLIC MARKET lettering.
Garden Center’s painted brick sign and exterior iron fire escape.
Stepped bluff foundations and exposed downhill lower storeys.
Warm amber shop windows and lanterns against dusk skies.
